block.shhs_create_core.brass_ender_chest: _Copy_/_Paste_ the _owner_ and _lock state_ of the Brass Ender Chest.

An Ender Chest that can interact with _funnels_, _chutes_, _packagers_, and other _logistics components_. It can only access the Ender Chest _Inventory_ of its _owner_. If the owner is _offline_, the Brass Ender Chest _cannot be interacted with_.
block.shhs_create_core.hostility_absorbe: Higher speed increases the absorption radius up to config limit.
Restores all cleared chunks within the last radius.
A dynamic absorber that clears hostile traits from chunks based on rotational speed.
block.shhs_create_core.sprayer.tooltip.b: Rotational speed controls a valve angle from 0 to 180 degrees, linearly adjusting the spray rate.
Sprays forward every 0.25 seconds, consuming up to 32 mB per spray when fully open.
block.shhs_create_core.sprayer.tooltip.c: Connect rotational power to the face
block.shhs_create_core.sprayer.tooltip.s: A sprayer that sprays fluid forward, with rate controlled by rotational input.
item.shhs_create_core.empty_trait.toolti: After _Charge_, _absorbs_ _one level_ of a random _Trait_ from the target and turns into its _Trait Item_.
An _Empty Vessel_ eager to absorb a little _Hostility_ from nearby creatures.
item.shhs_create_core.portable_stock_tic: If linked network exists and _is loaded_, opens a request menu.
If the target block is a _Stock Ticker_, _Stock Link_ or _Redstone Requester_, links to its network.
When used in Sneak on Blocks
Allows you to connect to a _Logistics Network_ and remotely view its stock information.
